newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia says untimed local calls to remain.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia says untimed local calls to remain.

text.p: The Australian government said on Tuesday it reaffirmed its commitment to untimed local calls in draft legislation for the deregulation of the telecommunications industry from July next year.

Communications minister Richard Alston said in a statement that the third package of draft legislation, released for public comment on Tuesday, clarified the rules and conditions for industry players in a deregulated environment.
